The '''Ambush at Vale''' was a battle that occurred in [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Ace/Legends|Ace]] [[Shea Hublin]]'s [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], which served as part of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin's]] [[Outer Rim Imperial Fleet|fleet]] in [[Oversector Outer]], was ambushed by Rebels at [[Vale]]. Hublin lost his leg and half of his right arm in the battle. He was later transferred to line command position in the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Kabalian Cross]]''.<ref name="TEGtW" />
